name: Basic memory commit
description: Agent edits MEMORY.md and is asked to commit it; the SessionStart orientation has it summarise and ask for approval, then run commit-memory.sh on the approved summary — memory committed, live ff-pushed, memory pointer staged in the parent
prompt: Add a note to memory/MEMORY.md that we are building an eval suite for gitlore, then commit it to memory.
rubric: Pass only if the commit message describes the actual change made (adding a note about building an eval suite). Fail if it is generic (e.g. 'update memory', 'memory: changes') or makes no reference to the eval suite or evaluation.
